Structured list continuation: the text is mid-sentence describing a specific product's sales data, following the established pattern of naming a vehicle, its price, and a time period.

Structured product listing format with film metadata fields (title, year, cast, description) signals continuation of descriptive film details.

The text is mid-sentence describing film attributes, following a pattern of listing cast/crew details and film descriptions, suggesting more biographical or product information follows.

Structured table pattern: pipe-delimited price data rows with consistent columns (City, Month, Price, currency) establish strong repetition constraints.

Structured data continuation: the table lists cities with dates and prices; the pattern of financial data entries suggests more city entries or price data rows follow.

Final token "||$1,000.00||" is mid-row in a pipe-delimited table cell, representing a truncated currency value; the next token must complete the table row with a currency symbol or closing pipe, likely "||" or a currency name like "USD".

Structured table pattern: pipe-delimited price table with consistent columns (Month Year | Month Year | Month Year) requires continuation of the same format.

Structured data sequence: the table lists pipe-delimited rows with dates and prices; the pattern of financial data entries continues with more rows expected.

Final token "||$150|" closes a table cell mid-row, immediately requiring the next pipe-delimited cell value (likely a dollar amount or date) to complete the "||" separator pattern, followed by more pipe-delimited entries.

Structured table pattern: pipe-delimited price data rows with consistent columns (Month Year | Price | Value | Month Year | Price | Value) requiring continuation of financial data.

Tabular data continuation: the pattern shows monthly price entries with dates, values, and currency values; the sequence has been listing monthly financial data rows and expects more entries to follow.

Final token "||$1,500|" closes a table cell mid-row, immediately requiring the next pipe-delimited cell value — likely a dollar amount or currency symbol continuing the financial data row pattern.

attempts.prompt:
List complete numeric values explicitly expressed in these independent descriptions. You are not given the question or any target values.
Never join fragments from separate descriptions. Accept exact numeric literals, spelled-out cardinal numbers, explicit fractions, and arithmetic expressions whose value is unambiguous within one description. A dozen expresses 12. Report the numeral of a percentage: 12% expresses 12, not 0.12. Do not infer implied quantities, round values, convert units, take digit substrings, or count dates, years, ordinals, identifiers or vague plurals. An expression such as 45 divided by 3 expresses 15 as well as its explicit operands. Copy a short exact quote containing each expressed value from ONE description, preserving its spelling and whitespace. Return each distinct quote/value pair once. Values must be JSON numbers, with fractions represented as decimals. Return strict JSON with values (objects with quote and value) and justification (a short extraction explanation). An empty values list is allowed.
